about.description: The Crab Trap is a waterfront seafood restaurant with three locations along the Florida panhandle offering beautiful views of the Gulf of Mexico and fresh local seafood. The restaurant operates its own wild fish processing facility called the Seafood Commissary, which prepares over 250,000 lbs of fresh-caught Gulf seafood annually including shrimp, grouper, snapper, mahi-mahi, cobia, wahoo, and amberjack.
about.elevator_pitch: Three waterfront Gulf seafood restaurants in Northwest Florida featuring fresh local catch and stunning Gulf views since 1991.
about.vibe: Casual waterfront dining with open air windows, sun bleached wood, local art, and hand carved seaside sculptures. Family-friendly atmosphere with beautiful Gulf of Mexico views.
about.insider_tip: Try the award-winning gumbo and the must-have wild Alaska crab legs. The original location in Destin is at James Lee Park.
